A Google Reviews scraping pipeline that derives diner sentiment, most-talked-about dishes, and topics in one hub.

The problem

(Add: what couldn't the restaurant/client see before this existed?)

The approach

Engineered and deployed a production NLP pipeline — BeautifulSoup and Selenium for scraping, VADER and BERTopic for sentiment and topic modeling — containerized with Docker and CI/CD.
